text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, brooding all by yourself, are we?
You've certainly picked up quite the grown-up pastime.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Is staring off into the sunset
something that only grown-ups do?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, beats me~☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So? What are your thoughts
on our final day of training, Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I was remembering all sorts of things.
Like how tough training used to be, and all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The joint pain isn't going away,
and this weird feeling in my body won't stop either...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And then?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, because you work so hard for me, Trainer,
things have become much easier recently than before."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Never taking your eyes off me,
noticing even the slightest change."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They talk to me so much.
So very much...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...You've met such a kind person, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"When we first met, I was hoping
I could give her all sorts of things."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But the truth is... Trainer, I'm sure you came into my life just for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I feel like
they gave me a reason to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...You might be right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to win the Sprinters Stakes
as a way of saying thanks."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"You can win, Flower.
You're always trying your best, after all."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...You can definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
I understand, I really do!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? What about it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You were always watching over me,
and whenever I was feeling down, you always cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Another person who's always, always by my side,
and is so very kind...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That someone as beautiful as the clear blue sky
is watching over me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going back!
Sky-san, what about you...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "...This might be my last chance to see it this year, so I'm gonna gaze at the ocean a bit longer."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
See you tomorrow then!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, you went and grew up
before I even realized it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's so unfair...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Flower-chan!
Just in time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's everyone gathered around for?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Before heading back to the dorms, we're all comparing heights.
Look, check out that pillar over there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Wah, there are so many lines drawn on it!
Could these be from all the girls who came before...?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it. When I asked the facility staff,
they said the building owner lent out that pillar
just for the Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-chan, come over here too!
I'll take your measurements!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

"After finishing our second summer training camp,
while waiting for Nishino Flower before boarding the bus—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!
This is terrible...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I grew a tiny bit taller...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Come next summer,
I might shoot up by like 10 centimeters all at once!

At first, she was bewildered by the changes in her body.
However, once she understood it was something to be celebrated, she learned to embrace her growth.

"Her gaze is much firmer now than when we first met.
Soon, she'll be standing shoulder to shoulder
with those 'big sisters' she always talked about—"
choice_data_list: I'm really glad to hear that.
That's really great news, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really starting to look forward
to the Sprinters Stakes...♪"

Foretelling further growth in both mind and body,
the second summer training camp came to an end.
